recentItems.title: Russian Drone Strike Kills 6 Civilians At Ukrainian Park, Zelenskyy Condemns Moscow's Attack
recentItems.description:
A Russian drone strike directly targeted a crowded central park in the town of Nova Vodolaha, killing six people, including three children. Strike  targeted the park when numerous families and young children were gathered in the central plaza southwest of Kharkiv city.

recentItems.title: ZELENSKYY'S ULTIMATUM TO TRUMP? Kyiv's Key Conditions To Halt Russian Oil Strikes; Demands Patriots
recentItems.description:
Is Zelenskyy issuing an ultimatum to Trump? Ukraine has laid out key conditions linked to a possible halt in strikes on Russian oil infrastructure, with air defence support, including US-made Patriot systems, emerging as a crucial demand. As Kyiv seeks stronger security guarantees and protection against Russian attacks, will Washington meet Ukraine’s demands? What does Zelenskyy want from Trump, and could this change the course of the Russia-Ukraine war?
